prompt.en: What might have been the advantages and challenges of ruling a large empire in the absence of modern communication systems? Answer in about 100 words, using the way kingdoms were divided and the work done at each level.

label.en: Dividing the kingdom into levels with officers made a large area easier to manage

level1.en: How did rulers organise a large kingdom?

clue.en: Kingdoms were divided into provinces, divisions, districts, groups of villages and villages, for administrative convenience. Provincial governors and district officers worked at these levels, while the king stayed supreme.

label.en: Local officers and village bodies could act on matters close to them

clue.en: District officers often consulted important residents such as bankers, caravan leaders, artisans and scribes. Village assemblies had small committees, the variyams, and villages were largely self-reliant in practical work.

label.en: Without fast communication, orders travelled slowly and far places were hard to control

level1.en: What was difficult about ruling a large empire without modern communication?

clue.en: A message had to be carried by a person, so it took a long time to reach a far place. The ruler could not see what happened there, and had to depend on his officers and on the villages themselves.
